# Load the libraries for the R script.

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(rvest)
library(xml2)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

```

# Scrape driver statistics and clean/transform data and save as external CSV file.

```{r}

url <- "https://www.formula1.com/en/results/2026/drivers"

driver_stats <- url %>% 
  read_html() %>% 
  html_nodes(xpath = '//*[@id="results-table"]/div/table') %>% 
  html_table()

driver_statistics <- driver_stats[[1]]

driver_stats_df <- as.data.frame(driver_statistics)

driver_stats_df$Driver <- substr(driver_stats_df$Driver, 1, nchar(driver_stats_df$Driver) - 3)

colnames(driver_stats_df) <- c("POS", "DRIVER", "NATIONALITY",
                               "TEAM", "POINTS")

driver_stats_df$DRIVER <- gsub("Â", "", driver_stats_df$DRIVER)       
driver_stats_df$DRIVER  <- gsub("\u00A0", " ", driver_stats_df$DRIVER)

driver_stats_df

write.csv(driver_stats_df, "latest_f1_driver_stats.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```


# Load the team stats and save as external CSV file. 

```{r}
library(httr)
library(rvest)
library(dplyr)

url <- "https://www.formula1.com/en/results/2026/team"

response <- GET(
  url,
  user_agent("Mozilla/5.0"),
  timeout(30)
)

page <- read_html(
  content(response, "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
)

# How many tables are present?
tables <- html_elements(page, "table")

print(length(tables))

# Inspect table contents
if (length(tables) > 0) {
  lapply(tables, html_table)
}
url <- "https://www.formula1.com/en/results/2026/team"

response <- tryCatch(
  GET(
    url,
    user_agent("Mozilla/5.0"),
    timeout(20)
  ),
  error = function(e) e
)

if (inherits(response, "error")) {
  message(conditionMessage(response))
} else {
  print(status_code(response))
  print(headers(response)[["content-type"]])
}

team_stats <- tables[[1]] %>%
  html_table(fill = TRUE) %>%
  as_tibble()

print(team_stats)

write.csv(team_stats, "team_stats.csv", row.names = FALSE)


```


# Calculate the individual driver ratios. 

```{r}

library(dplyr)

f1_df <- read.csv(
  "latest_f1_driver_stats.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

driver_ratios <- f1_df %>%
  group_by(TEAM) %>%
  mutate(
    TEAM_POINTS = sum(POINTS, na.rm = TRUE),

    DRIVER_RATIO = if_else(
      TEAM_POINTS > 0,
      POINTS / TEAM_POINTS,
      NA_real_
    ),

    DRIVER_PCT = round(DRIVER_RATIO * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(DRIVER_RATIO), desc(POINTS)) %>%
  mutate(
    RANK = if_else(
      is.na(DRIVER_RATIO),
      NA_integer_,
      rank(-DRIVER_RATIO, ties.method = "min",
           na.last = "keep") %>% as.integer()
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    RANK,
    DRIVER,
    TEAM,
    POINTS,
    TEAM_POINTS,
    DRIVER_RATIO,
    DRIVER_PCT
  )

print(driver_ratios, n = Inf)


write.csv(
  driver_ratios,
  "f1_driver_contribution_ratios.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


```
